_note: Team rule for the prototype planner, NOT an official standard. AQI is the US-EPA PM2.5 AQI the data layer computes (indicative: hourly model values). AQI 100 is Yash's safe line in the web app. Official GRAP/CAQM and Directorate of Education orders always win.

decision_max_aqi._note: Per activity intensity: outdoors up to `outdoors`, moved indoors up to `indoors`, restricted (cancelled) above it.

status_max_aqi._note: Overall status from the worst forecast AQI during school hours. Above `restricted` is emergency.

smoke._note: If the indicative smoke trace for that part of the day says smoke_likely, every outdoor activity is one step stricter, and the day is at least caution. Afternoon = slots starting at or after this IST time.

default_schedule.indoors: Hold assembly in the hall or over the PA system.
default_schedule.indoors_hi: प्रार्थना सभा हॉल में या माइक से कक्षाओं में करें।
default_schedule.restricted: Skip assembly; class teachers take attendance in classrooms.
default_schedule.restricted_hi: प्रार्थना सभा न करें; कक्षा में ही हाज़िरी लें।

default_schedule.indoors: Light indoor PE: stretching, yoga or table tennis in the hall.
default_schedule.indoors_hi: हॉल में हल्की कसरत: स्ट्रेचिंग, योग या टेबल टेनिस।
default_schedule.restricted: No PE today; use the period for a health talk or reading.
default_schedule.restricted_hi: आज पीटी नहीं; इस समय स्वास्थ्य पर बातचीत या पढ़ाई करें।

default_schedule.indoors: Indoor recess in classrooms, windows closed.
default_schedule.indoors_hi: मध्यावकाश कक्षा में, खिड़कियाँ बंद रखें।
default_schedule.restricted: Short indoor break only; no running in corridors.
default_schedule.restricted_hi: केवल छोटा ब्रेक कक्षा में; गलियारों में दौड़ना नहीं।

default_schedule.indoors: Eat in classrooms or the cafeteria, windows closed.
default_schedule.indoors_hi: भोजन कक्षा या कैंटीन में करें, खिड़कियाँ बंद रखें।
default_schedule.restricted: Eat in classrooms; no outdoor play after lunch.
default_schedule.restricted_hi: भोजन कक्षा में; खाने के बाद बाहर खेलना नहीं।

default_schedule.indoors: Indoor drills and light fitness in the hall.
default_schedule.indoors_hi: हॉल में हल्का अभ्यास और फ़िटनेस।
default_schedule.restricted: Cancel practice; students go home at dismissal.
default_schedule.restricted_hi: अभ्यास रद्द; छात्र छुट्टी पर घर जाएँ।

default_schedule.indoors: Students wait inside until their pickup arrives; masks on for the walk home.
default_schedule.indoors_hi: बच्चे लेने वाले के आने तक अंदर रुकें; घर जाते समय मास्क पहनें।
default_schedule.restricted: Staggered pickup from inside the building only; masks on.
default_schedule.restricted_hi: केवल इमारत के अंदर से बारी-बारी से छुट्टी; मास्क पहनें।
